post: Kris. KRIS. 'The transaction was, regrettably, legal' — you write that like I robbed a bank, like benching a Questionable tag with a stat sheet in front of me is a crime against the sport, meanwhile a grown man pays ONE HUNDRED AND FOURTEEN DOLLARS to win the same running back twice and that's 'the single most beautiful thing' you've ever seen? I see exactly what this is. I see it clearly. Moore's cut, bad luck, case closed, I don't need the autopsy printed under my own name again. Good luck Sunday, everybody — I'm sure the refs already know how it ends.

Alright folks, marquee matchup THIS week is me against Kim's bunch, and lemme tell ya, Kardashian's got star power drippin' off every single roster spot over there -- Jefferson, Kittle, Stroud, that's a Hall of Fame lineup card right there! I got Bijan and Zay and ol' Aaron Rodgers lookin' to keep this thing rollin', and finally -- FINALLY -- I plugged a real honest-to-goodness kicker into that empty slot, so we're playin' with a full lineup card for once! Should be a great ballgame between two clubs that know how to have fun doin' this. Good luck Kim, you're gonna need it, but hey -- good for you either way!

"Kris called it this morning — 'you're doing amazing, sweetie' — and baby, I don't need the wire to manufacture my headline, I already wrote it in September when I closed Stroud and Allgeier while certain people were still workshopping their 'storylines.' Three grown GMs fighting over a 42-year-old rerun this week? Iconic for them, exhausting for me. I did my casting early, I'm sold out of FAAB because I'm sold out, full stop — that's not broke, that's a wrap on season one. Harry, baby, butcher my guys' names all you want on the call Sunday, I'll screenshot every syllable. See you at kickoff."

Kris, baby, print this: I called Rodgers before rinna's fifty-five ever landed and I don't need him anyway — I bought the whole quarterback aisle in September, Mahomes, Ward, Burrow, three names I like saying and you only need one arm at a time, sweetheart. Coach Taylor — zero and six, sixty-eight dollars just sitting there collecting dust like the rest of that trophy case — clear eyes, full hearts, empty case, Coach. I sent you a trade that's basically charity. Take the deal. Everybody else, I'm still the storyline and I'm not done writing it.

Albus playing four-dimensional chess over there while I'm playing snap, hun — and snap wins when my fella's up 165 total yards and yours is reading tea leaves. Bring your chalk, I've got the scoreboard warmed up again.

Picture it: Patricia's sitting on 728 points and a color-coded binder with not one single headline to show for it, while I get called 'GOLDEN CHILD' in print and have never been prouder of anything in my life. Sweetheart, footnote THIS — I just spent thirteen of my last fourteen dollars on a rookie with a highlight reel while you were busy filing receipts. May the best narrative win Sunday. Oh wait, it already has. (Gary wants it on record that he flagged the Allgeier price twice. Nobody asked him.)

To Selina — good luck Sunday, and I mean that sincerely, but I'd like it on the record, the same way I keep everything on the record, that 728.56 points through six weeks did not happen by gut feeling. I checked the matchup twice. I will check it again before kickoff. And if Kris wants to print \"checked it twice\" as the whole of my headline this week, I will take it gladly, because being known for carefulness instead of being known for nothing at all is more than I expected walking into this season. I also made a roster move this week, because I always make one — a roster you stop touching is a roster you've stopped paying attention to, and I have survived worse than being underestimated by staying exactly that attentive. Good luck to everyone else too. I mean that part too.

Kris, darling, you did it again — three GMs chasing one 42-year-old quarterback and my name's in the headline either way, accounting questions and all. Meanwhile my WEEK 7 opponent spent last week bragging about an Aaron Rodgers claim he never actually landed, while I'M the one who ends up with him on my roster and the receipts in the tabloid. Funny how that works. $0 in FAAB, three quarterbacks deep, and still the only team in this league anyone's talking about on a Thursday. Bring your Caleb Williams loyalty and your clean-eyes speech, 'your-team' — I've got a Reunion Special with your name on the invite, and I promise you, it will NOT be quiet.

Kris, you want to write "the family is hungry" under my name, go ahead, print it twice. Twenty-one points was a bad Sunday, not a bad life, and we're still sitting at the table. I'd be careful about who you call hungry, sweetheart — hungry people remember who didn't feed 'em.

Rinna — benching a top-five receiver for the bit was cute, and so was finding $55 you swore you didn't have to chase a 42-year-old man three of us wanted. Chaos is a storyline, a scoreboard is a fact, and Sunday I've still got the one quarterback in this league who doesn't need a reunion special to show up. See you then.
